title: Undo drawer: Floor ticket
summary: A nonnegative event pushes that value onto a stack. A negative event removes up to abs(event) values from its top. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
An experimental filing machine records both new cards and requests to undo recent cards. Ada is checking the lower stop before the ribbon press opens. A negative reading is a real measurement and must not be replaced by an invented zero.

A nonnegative event pushes that value onto a stack. A negative event removes up to abs(event) values from its top. Produce the final stack from bottom to top.

Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement undoDrawerFloorTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Stack history. A nonnegative event pushes that value onto a stack. A negative event removes up to abs(event) values from its top. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with stack history. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.
